item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 23/Jan/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be relatively mild during the day over the region. The easterly airstream is expected to strengthen slightly during the weekend. A cold front will move across southern China on Sunday. The associated intense winter monsoon will bring cold and very dry weather to the coastal areas early next week. It will be very cold in the morning over inland areas. Under the persistent influence of the monsoon, temperatures in the morning and at night will remain relatively low midweek next week.
